title: Schema markup generator
description: Build JSON-LD for a page from facts we already stored about it. Nothing is invented: a field we cannot back with a fact is left out, and we say why.

new.title: Generate markup
new.description: Pick a page, pick a type, then read what it costs before you confirm.

source.inventoryLegend: Pages missing a supported schema type
source.auditedEmpty: Run an audit first and its pages show up here.
source.inventoryEmpty: No inventory page is missing a supported schema type right now.
source.urlHint: We read the page once over a safe connection. Only public addresses work.
source.urlInvalid: Enter a full https address, with no user name or password in it.

type.alreadyDeclared: This page already declares this type.

preview.title: What this costs
preview.remaining: Left on your plan this month: {{remaining}}.
preview.noFit: This does not fit in what is left. Add credits or change plan first.

result.title: {{type}} markup
result.downloadFailed: We could not fetch the file. Try again.
result.failedProvider: The model did not answer, so no markup was kept.
result.failedRejected: Every field the model offered failed our fact check, so we kept only what we could prove.
result.evidenceDescription: One line per field in the markup, naming the stored fact behind it.
result.evidenceEmpty: No field could be filled from a stored fact.
result.omissionsDescription: Fields with no fact behind them, and the reason each one is missing.

reason.no_evidence: we hold no fact for it
reason.evidence_ambiguous: the facts we hold do not agree
reason.not_applicable: it does not apply to this page

conformance.title: Check against schema.org
conformance.conforms: This markup conforms to schema.org requirements for type {{type}}.
conformance.gaps: This markup does not yet conform to schema.org requirements for type {{type}}.
conformance.requiredTitle: Fill these to meet the requirements
conformance.recommendedSuggestion: You could add {{property}} once we hold a fact for it.
